protocol.seed_scope: Reused development seeds; not fresh confirmation
protocol.difference: Only after contact first observed under shooting and subsequent pass command, use the reset-state backward goal in the same AH-BFM
protocol.goal_source: First observation backward feature after each physics reset; caller starts policy at reset
protocol.success: Both kicks direction <=10 degrees, preferred foot, forward speed error <=30%, no failure through 20 seconds
protocol.checkpoint_selection: Metadata-only fixed candidate; no automatic promotion
